Branex Hay · Buckley

We grow it ourselves.

Most feed stores order hay. This one is the retail arm of a family hay operation — the Andersons cut, test, and haul it themselves, so the same fields that fill semi-trucks fill the barn out back.

20+ varietiesof hay in the barn, year-round
NSC-testedlow-sugar hay for metabolic horses
Any size loadsemi-loads down to a single bale — delivery from $50

The name on the sign

BRANdon + ilEXis = Branex.

The sign out front is literally the two of them.

Brandon and Ilexis Anderson were hay people first — a family operation in Buckley moving hay by the truckload, formed as an LLC in October 2020. Two years on the trucks taught them what the plateau's smaller farms and backyard keepers were missing, so in October 2022 they opened the storefront on SE 436th St.

Now the same family that cuts the hay hands it over the counter — and answers the feed questions that come with it.

Hay's in the barn. Come get it.

Halfway between Enumclaw and Buckley — look for the red peak on the sign.
